about_the_game:
When a covert global peacekeeping treaty collapses into chaos, elite strike teams once bound by secrecy are unleashed onto the battlefield. Black Ember was meant to prevent the next great war. Instead, it lit the fuse.

In a world where military black-ops units, rogue PMCs, and urban warfare squads fight for control of classified zones, the line between soldier and shadow has vanished. As the conflict spreads, deniable engagements erupt in cities, bunkers, and fractured borderlands around the globe. No headlines. No records. Just the mission, and the kill count.

Black Ember delivers pure multiplayer FPS action built for high-stakes, tactical combat. No campaign. No cutscenes. Just boots on the ground and steel in your hands. From tight urban firefights to rural extraction zones, every round demands skill, coordination, and fast decisions.

Black Ember gives players full PC-focused control with advanced settings for graphics, FOV, keybinding, and performance tuning. Run it in 4K and push frame rates past 120.

Choose your faction. Lock in your operator. Equip a modern arsenal built for precision, power, and custom playstyles. Old-school weapons are also available through unlocks for those who know how to earn them.

Play core game modes like Team Deathmatch, Domination, Capture the Flag, and Free-For-All. Each map is designed for raw intensity and strategic depth, with no filler — just combat.

Black Ember is the war that never made the news.
Suit up. Move fast. Leave nothing behind.
